properties.rationale: Deferred on Anthony's word, 2026-07-28. Captured the same day and accepted: the graph owns the MAP from epoch/increment to the git ref that holds it, rather than duplicating what git already stores. Scheduled for a later increment. The backward-direction precedent already exists in-repo (rel:v0180 in the graph, tag v0.18.0 in git), so this extends a working division of labour rather than opening a new one.
